title: xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model
summary: Starting September 21st, xAI will stop charging a flat fee for Grok’s X Search calls and begin billing for every post and user profile returned. For products that depend on large-scale X ingestion, the difference could be significant. RuntimeWire was architected around a different assumption: use human editorial judgment to narrow the field first, then let machines investigate deeply.
